summary: The WorkReadPort implementation for PgWorkStore: five thin methods that validate project access and delegate to the per-method free functions in the work_read_* modules. No SQL in this file.
responsibilities: Each method calls work_common::require_project first, then delegates: get -> work_read_get::get, list_tasks -> work_read_list::list_tasks (which itself routes scope filters to work_read_scope::list_scope), events -> work_read_events::events, result -> work_read_result::result, cicd_stage_log -> work_read_cicd::cicd_stage_log. Arguments pass through unchanged.
invariants: No SQL, no shaping, no error invention in this file: delegation only.
